svg.text: Real 100-vertex edge topologies parsed from cnf-orig/: Watts–Strogatz rewiring interpolates ring lattice → random graph
Benchmark Origin (Gent, Hoos, Prosser & Walsh): 100 vertices (5 colors → 500 vars, 3,100 clauses); rewiring probability interpolates easy lattice → hard small-world.
Visual Key: Slate perimeter arcs = local ring-lattice edges (d ≤ 4); colored interior chords = rewired small-world shortcuts (d > 4); all 5 instances SAT.
